title: Down the Hill
summary: On Day four, Wren leaves the studio to bring Tilly out of the school, and she cannot make a sound.

beats.text: I had to walk down a hill of hunting dead without making one sound.
Cal stayed on the mast, holding the mute switch by hand. Rain hid how his arm shook.
The lobby doors were glass. Four of them leaned on it, swaying.
I crouched under a canopy while a crowd shuffled past.
The school rose out of the rain. One window glowed upstairs. Tilly's.
I tapped twice on the door. Our code. Nothing answered.
Then a whisper came through the wood: "Wren? Is that you? I'm coming."
beats.speaker: tilly

beats.text: Behind her, the classroom radio crackled and began to speak.
"Wren, don't open it," said Cal's voice. "That is not Tilly."
beats.speaker: cal

beats.text: But I had left Cal a mile up the hill, on the mast, holding the switch.
